description: Heart to Heart Trust Found - Heart to Heart Trust Fund (Incorporation) Act No. 10 of 2024
categorisation: This gazette contains rules made by the Heart to Heart Trust Fund regarding its incorporation, name, address, objects, powers, management structure, and financial operations. The content focuses on business registration matters, organizational rules, and operational guidelines for a corporate entity, which falls under commercial/business matters rather than government personnel, structure, land, legal, or other specialized categories.
